checks: Anonymous users can open Search Cars from dealer 21 and see all five inventory records.
All five filters reproduce the lab example: Audi A6, 2022, 5,000 miles, $70,000.
At 390px width all filters and the result card fit without horizontal page overflow.
No-match recovery, individual All selections, reset and make/model changes restore the correct records.
Direct page refresh and Back to dealership navigation work.
Model names with spaces reach the API correctly and select their matching make.
A valid dealer with no inventory and an unknown dealer display distinct states.
A browser-simulated inventory HTTP 502 displays an error; retry recovers from the live service.
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors occurred.
